alternatives_not_adopted.summary: Precision PCB fabricator able to hold Ø0.05 pattern position and 2.8 +0.1/-0 holes with the same HARTING parts
Separately designed adapter board or different connector pair (for example press-fit variant)

exclusions.reason: Upstream supply feed into A01:J-PWR:middle is the instrument power distribution boundary (Stage10 upstream_power_boundaries)

exclusions.scope: LED_local_copper and other board-local edges of the Stage15 graph

exclusions.reason: Representative A01 only; replication is not authorized
exclusions.scope: A02-A06 and the other 33 instrument functions

exclusions.reason: O1 front links, factory terminals and DIN labels have an OPEN mating-face transform and unresolved alternatives; not geometry-bound in the locked frame
Panel hardware and fixed devices are locked; only their terminals are endpoints
No chassis bond is defined in the ledger

gh.candidate_reason: JST states 1.0 A only at AWG26; the Stage10 power-return contract retains a 0.5 A GH contact current limit. One gauge for all GH conductors avoids mixed stock.
gh.termination: Crimp SSHL-002T-P0.2 with the JST-specified applicator/die, insert into GHR-0nV-S; both ends identical housing
gh.voltage_basis: Connector rating 50 V AC/DC; system rails span 24 V (-12 to +12 V). Wire rating must not be below the connector rating.

inspection.limit: Each conductor end-to-end continuous; mated GH contact 30 mOhm initial max each (JST); two-contact 0.06 Ohm initial (Stage10 contract)
No continuity between different nets in the same harness or stack

inspection.limit_status: UNDETERMINED: test voltage and limit to be agreed (Q-H04); JST connector 100 MOhm min is a connector rating, not a harness limit
UNDETERMINED: workmanship class to be agreed (Q-H04, Q-A06)
inspection.method: Visual: crimp form, insulation, solder fillet, no exposed conductor beyond the land

inspection.limit_status: UNDETERMINED: per JST crimp spec / agreed standard
inspection.method: Sample crimp pull test per lot

inspection.limit: Housing fully latched; audible/tactile lock per JST
inspection.method: Visual and tug test by housing, never by wire

inspection.limit_status: UNDETERMINED until anchors are defined (M-09, M-12)

inspection.limit: Each conductor ID readable at both ends; matches ledger

o1_rear_trimmer_constraint.rule: Any future O1 harness must keep each rear trimmer 6 mm tool cylinder clear along the rear approach; not evaluated here because O1 harness geometry is not bound in the locked frame.

route.step: Bare boards (A01-middle, A01-core): JLC multilayer FR4 ENIG with the ±0.05 finished-hole option on the 192 DIN contact holes, if confirmed for soldered holes; Ø0.05 pattern position and 2.8 mm fixing holes confirmed in writing; first-article hole report
PCBA: SMD reflow, then assembler wave/selective THT of the exact HARTING parts in a seating fixture; AOI/visual plus THT class inspection records
Harnesses: four GH cables and 14 permanent tails built, terminated, labeled and 100% tested by the assembler or a harness vendor at lengths fixed only after fit-up measurement
Unpowered fit-up and service rehearsal on the first stack; no energization in this route definition

tail.candidate_reason: Same stock as GH conductors; outer diameter must be strictly below the Stage10 carrier wire guide minimum open diameter. PROPOSAL only.
tail.clearance_status: UNDETERMINED: OD must be strictly below the Stage10 guide minimum open diameter; margin from wire maker/harness vendor (Q-H03)
tail.termination: Factory solder at both ends: fixed-device side (LED wire land or jack S/T terminal) and A01-jack tail land; strain relieved at the carrier guide, solder joint not a mechanical anchor
